findings.item: exactly R atoms and weak localizer
findings.reason: Equality of affine and quadratic evaluation spaces makes the affine space coordinate-multiplication closed, hence it contains all finite-support delta functions. Thus N=R and affine single-atom interpolation is available. g_i*q_s^2 is degree<=3, so the original weak affine localizer yields each atom load<=T.

In weighted L2 evaluation, A_e are diagonal 0/1 projections. A prefix is a joint-support projection, and G-HS squared is its rank/count. Legal children partition count; greedy retains positive count, ending at one supported original-T assignment. Probability mass is ||K v0||_G^2, generally different.

findings.reason: G/H_e/A_e and exact comparisons are rational. Splitting v0 by each job keeps at most R orthogonal nonzero branches and recovers positive rational weights and degree-4 moments. Fixed-matrix denominator Q^n and polynomial numerator growth give polynomial total bit time in explicit (P,T,eta,y); no inverse-weight or spectral oracle.
